questions.text: I'm new here. Where do I start?
questions.answer: Welcome! Walk with W A S D or the arrow keys, and walk up to any agent to ask it something in the chat. Odin knows what is happening here right now, Atlas answers from the company's knowledge base, and I help when something does not work. Every answer comes with a proof card: what was asked, the answer, why, and where it came from. Not sure whom to ask? Ask Odin "who can help me with ..." and he walks you there.
